_readme.covers: Units 22-26. Leading-tone seventh chords, mixture, applied dominants and applied leading-tone chords, and diatonic modulation.
_readme.structure: Every rule has: rule_id, tier, category, weight, error_message, check.
_readme.note_on_scope: Most seventh-chord resolution and generic leading-tone resolution is already handled by Pass 2's seventh_resolution and leading_tone_resolution. Pass 5 adds the applied cases (V/x, vii°/x) plus mixture resolution.
how_to_add_a_rule: 1. Copy a rule block between { and }.
2. Give it a new unique rule_id.
3. Choose a check.type that a pass module has registered.
6. Save. No trailing comma after the last rule.

rules.error_message: Applied leading tone did not resolve up to the tonic of the target key — check the soprano and bass
Applied leading tone is doubled — the third of V/x or the root of vii°/x must never be doubled
Borrowed b6 did not resolve down by step to 5 — the chromatic tone of a mixture chord has a strong downward tendency
